investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Summittrail Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.81.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster summit-prod-useast (EKS); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for app-frontend; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
